create_Min_metric: create a Min metric instance to track the minimum value across updates
create_Max_metric: create a Max metric instance to track the maximum value across updates
create_Mean_metric: create a Mean metric instance to compute the running average of values
create_Sum_metric: create a Sum metric instance to accumulate the sum of values with optional weights
update_metric_with_value: update a Min Max Mean or Sum metric with an int float or Tensor value
